manifest.source: UCF-101 (Soomro et al. 2012) via the Hugging Face mirror MichiganNLP/ucf-101 (UCF101.zip, ZIP repack of the official RAR); official split 1 (groups separate dev and test). 8 frames per clip at 64x64; ResNet-18 ImageNet embedding averaged over frames; pixel and shared-pattern checks on a 2x2 mosaic of 4 frames (32x32). Attacks on decoded frames.
manifest.policy: Tune only on the dev split (trainlist01 groups); the test split (testlist01 groups) is the headline. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change.
